newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chevron unit secures China onshore oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Chevron unit secures China onshore oil deal.

text.p: Oil major Chevron Corp unit Chevron Overseas Petroleum Ltd said on Friday it had secured an onshore oil production-sharing contract with China's main oil producer China National Petroleum Corp.
The deal, Chevron's first onshore oil exploration contract in China, is for a 1,800 square km (695 sq mile) land tract in the Shengli Field Complex in China's Shandong province, it said.
The Shengli Field Complex is the second-largest oil field in China, with daily production of some 650,000 barrels of crude.

Chevron will evaluate geologic data previously gathered in the tract, plan drilling programmes and operate the tract. It has 100 percent interest in the project during the exploration phase. It did not give other details.
